title: Spiral Demon

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Sophie encountered an army of Spiral Demons whilst trapped in the dreamworld created by [[Arc]], in which she found herself as leader of the [[Casterwill family]]. They crawled up the walls of the tower before the dream transferred them to a chess game between Sophie, and [[the Betrayer]]. After dispatching [[LeBlanche]], the Spiral Demons moved closer to [[Mallory]], [[White]], [[Dellix]], [[Lane]] and [[Santiago]]. full_text:
The Spiral Demons were magical constructs concocted by Arc, the Legendary Titan of Fate, in Sophie Casterwill's dream, to attack the Casterwill family. As minions of the Betrayer, these insidious monsters appear to be grotesque hybrids of the Marauder and Black Scarabese Titans.

History

Sophie encountered an army of Spiral Demons whilst trapped in the dreamworld created by Arc, in which she found herself as leader of the Casterwill family. They crawled up the walls of the tower before the dream transferred them to a chess game between Sophie, and the Betrayer. After dispatching LeBlanche, the Spiral Demons moved closer to Mallory, White, Dellix, Lane and Santiago. In an attempt to save her family, Sophie stormed the chessboard, kicking back as many Spiral Demons as she could, however this caused the whole board to collapse, with everyone on it falling to their doom. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

Abilities

With the upper torso of the Titan Marauder, the Spiral Demon possesses two blades. Its lower torso of the Black Scarabese allows its to effectively climb up walls with ease, as they did the Casterwill compound, and siege enemy defenses. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

Trivia

• The Spiral Demon was not named onscreen but are called as such in its official concept art.

The '''Spiral Demons''' were magical constructs concocted by [[Arc]], the [[Legendary Titan]] of Fate, in [[Sophie Casterwill]]'s dream, to attack the [[Casterwill family]]. As minions of [[the Betrayer]], these insidious monsters appear to be grotesque hybrids of the [[Marauder]] and [[Black Scarabese]] [[Titans]].

== History ==
Sophie encountered an army of Spiral Demons whilst trapped in the dreamworld created by [[Arc]], in which she found herself as leader of the [[Casterwill family]]. They crawled up the walls of the tower before the dream transferred them to a chess game between Sophie, and [[the Betrayer]]. After dispatching [[LeBlanche]], the Spiral Demons moved closer to [[Mallory]], [[White]], [[Dellix]], [[Lane]] and [[Santiago]]. In an attempt to save her family, Sophie stormed the chessboard, kicking back as many Spiral Demons as she could, however this caused the whole board to collapse, with everyone on it falling to their doom. {{source|The Legendary Titan of Fate}}

== Abilities ==
With the upper torso of the [[Titan]] [[Marauder]], the Spiral Demon possesses two blades. Its lower torso of the [[Black Scarabese]] allows its to effectively climb up walls with ease, as they did the Casterwill compound, and siege enemy defenses. {{source|The Legendary Titan of Fate}}
